+    def _get_endpoint_context(self) -> str:
+        """
+        Extract endpoint context once per endpoint and cache it.
+
+        Returns:
+            str: The endpoint context, or an empty string if none is available.
+        """
+        if not hasattr(self, "_endpoint_context"):
+            context = []
+            try:
+                # Get the route handler and its metadata
+                route_handler = self.operations[self.path_operation_name]
+                # Use inspect to get source line/function name (pydantic v2 only)
+                import inspect
+                signature = inspect.signature(route_handler.signature)
+                frame = inspect.currentframe()
+                if frame and frame.f_back:
+                    source_line = inspect.getsourcelines(frame.f_back.f_code.co_filename, frame.f_back.f_lineno)
+                    source_line = source_line[0].strip()
+                    context.append(f"  File \"{frame.f_back.f_code.co_filename}\", line {frame.f_back.f_lineno}, in {frame.f_back.f_code.co_name}")
+                else:
+                    context.append("")
+                context.append(f"    {route_handler.http_method.upper()} {self.path_url}")
+                if route_handler.name:
+                    context.append(f"    {route_handler.name}")
+            except (ValueError, AttributeError, IndexError, TypeError):
+                # Some operations (e.g. include_router) have no source or metadata
+                pass
